name: {brand.display_name}
_notes: Plumber and HVACBusiness are both schema.org LocalBusiness subtypes (under HomeAndConstructionBusiness). Plumbing-led clients emit @type Plumber as primary with additionalType HVACBusiness when they also offer heating/air (the All Pro Plumbing Heating and Air shape). For a rare HVAC-led client, Skill 3 may swap the two.

brand.hours_specification is resolved from brand.hours at build time. Emit an around-the-clock OpeningHoursSpecification ONLY when brand.hours actually says 24/7 (same gate as Header/TrustStrip/schema.ts); otherwise emit the brand's real business hours.
